project.name: Tower Peril (Spec B)
project.description: Pin-pull rescue puzzle with a light auto-battler merge/gacha meta-layer. IAP/gacha- driven monetization play: gem gacha rolls, merge-3 unit upgrades, a season-pass subscription, and an interstitial-after-every-level ad pacing policy. libGDX multi-module project: core (pure Java game logic + tests), android (APK via android-maven-plugin), ios (IPA via robovm-maven-plugin).
